question.q: Text A supports online lectures because students can replay lessons. Text B warns that some students lack reliable internet access. Which combined conclusion is most reasonable?
question.correct: Replayable lessons are useful, but schools should address unequal access.
wrong: Both texts agree that online learning is always harmful.
Text B proves nobody can use online lectures.
Text A denies that internet access is required.
question.exp: 兩文分別說明優點與限制，整合需兼顧重播功能與可近性。
question.subject: 英文

question.q: Text A: 'Cities should expand bike lanes to reduce traffic emissions.' Text B: 'Bike lanes work best when they connect homes to schools, shops, and transit stations.' How do the views relate?
question.correct: Text B adds a design condition to the goal described in Text A.
wrong: Text B rejects all low-carbon transportation.
Both texts discuss only bicycle manufacturing.
Text A argues that bike lanes should never connect important places.
question.exp: A 提倡政策目的，B 補充實現效果的路網連接條件。
question.subject: 英文

question.q: Text A: 'Planting street trees can reduce summer heat.' Text B: 'Tree planting must consider underground pipes and future maintenance costs.' Which combined conclusion is best supported?
question.correct: Trees can help reduce heat, but planting plans must account for practical constraints.
wrong: Text B proves that trees never reduce heat.
Both texts argue that pipes are the only cause of urban heat.
Text A shows that maintenance costs are always zero.
question.exp: Text A states a potential benefit; Text B adds implementation conditions. The combined interpretation retains both the benefit and the constraints.
question.subject: 英文

question.q: Text A: 'Remote work can reduce commuting.' Text B: 'Some workers lack suitable home offices.' What is the main difference between the texts?
question.correct: Text A highlights a benefit, while Text B identifies a limitation.
wrong: Both texts reject remote work in every circumstance.
Text A focuses only on home equipment; Text B only on commuting.
Text B supplies proof that no worker can work remotely.
question.exp: The texts emphasize different aspects of the same practice: a possible reduction in commuting and unequal access to home-work conditions.
question.subject: 英文

references.design: 重視圖表精確解讀、語境、禮貌及不同證據的整合

question.q: Text A says a school garden improved student interest in science; Text B reports that interest rose in both garden and non-garden schools during the same year. What is the strongest combined inference?
question.correct: The garden may help, but other factors may also explain the rise in interest.
wrong: The garden alone must explain every increase across all schools.
The absence of a garden guarantees that interest cannot increase.
Text B proves that garden programs always reduce interest.
question.exp: The comparison in Text B raises alternative explanations and makes an exclusive causal claim unsupported.
question.subject: 英文
